title: Gas pressure expression
description: Essential: The final answer for p₁ must be correctly expressed as p₀ + mg/(2S).

title: Force balance on pistons
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to the connected pistons, relating forces from gas pressure, atmosphere, and the suspended mass.

title: Rod force elimination
description: Important: The internal force in the connecting rod must be correctly eliminated when combining the force balance equations for the two pistons.

title: Final temperature value
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for T₂ must be 330 K (or equivalent).

title: Isobaric process recognition
description: Important: The solution must identify that the heating process occurs at constant pressure (p₁) after the initial equilibrium is found.

title: Volume change calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the initial and final total gas volumes using the given cylinder dimensions and piston areas.

title: Ideal gas law application
description: Important: For part (2), the ideal gas law (V/T = constant) must be correctly applied to the isobaric process.

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for incorrectly setting up force directions (e.g., wrong sign for mg or rod force), leading to an incorrect pressure expression.

title: Area confusion in pressure
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for using the wrong piston area (S vs. 3S) when calculating force from pressure (F = pA).

title: Volume miscalculation
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for an arithmetic error in calculating the initial (9LS) or final (11LS) total gas volume, leading to an incorrect T₂.
